findings.detail: The persistent component and CLI accept a database locator, explicitly scope liability to this database, and do not supply task authority. Paid worker calls do not themselves consume a ledger grant. A per-database cap is not one global $10/day dispatch boundary.

findings.detail: Legacy JSONL init overwrites totals, and charge performs unlocked read/check/append. Two readers of one epoch can both succeed with the same next epoch and the last line loses a charge. Negative charge input is not rejected. The whole module is not pure and its atomicity comments are not enforcement evidence.
findings.activation_acceptance: Retire this path from paid execution authority; expose canonical ledger observations through the CLI and describe only the selection core as pure. Never reuse old JSONL tests as evidence for the new global cap.

findings.detail: Public posterior constructors and nonempty evidence-reference strings do not authenticate qualification. Repeated references can increment trials. Posterior mean and a minimum trial count do not establish a reliability confidence bound; declared priors must remain separate from independently verified outcomes.
